_doc: Per language of langid.json, from its CLDR locale and its regional locales (params.json regional_status), each with inheritance (und: root, numeric patterns only): Gregorian month names (1..12), weekday names (Sunday..Saturday; weekdays_wide: the wide ones alone) and day periods (am, pm), abbreviated and wide, format and stand-alone; the date and time patterns of params.json (UTS #35 symbols) that dates and times are recognised by; the decimal and grouping separators of their default numbering systems (an alias to another system followed), the language's first; the calendars of its likely territory (calendarPreferenceData), preferred first. calendars: each such calendar's system (calendarData: solar, lunar, lunisolar, other), the start of its current era, and whether its months are the Gregorian ones (root aliases).
_source: generated by scripts/update-locale-data.sh from the pinned CLDR, UDHR in XML and Unicode security data (pin.json) with the parameters of params.json; never edit by hand
